title: FP8 activation safeguard orchestrator and cross-variant calibration matrix
creator: Asha Menon
description: Purpose: Orchestrate a robust FP8 enablement path for Hopper-class GPUs that selects between E4M3 and E5M2 profiles automatically, provides runtime safety nets, and validates accuracy/cost trade-offs across model shapes. Background: prior FP8 enablement efforts surfaced intermittent accuracy drift on a small subset of transformer layers when switching to E4M3. Rather than a blunt on/off rollout, we need a repeatable orchestration layer that calibrates profiles per-model, emits deterministic telemetry for gating, and falls back gracefully to INT8 or mixed FP32 paths. Goals: 1) Implement an activation orchestrator that chooses profile per-model and per-batch based on calibration score; 2) Add a lightweight safety net shim in the runtime to detect per-request signature drift and trigger immediate fallback; 3) Ship a cross-variant calibration matrix and golden-eval suite for continuous validation; 4) Integrate telemetry and rollout gating into the Console for canary visibility. Success metrics: - No >0.5% relative accuracy regressions on golden prompt set across 90% of tested models during canary; - Latency overhead of orchestrator <= 3ms P95; - Auto-fallback triggers less than 0.1% of requests in steady-state after 2 weeks. Approach summary: - Calibration orchestrator: offline calibration job produces per-layer scale statistics and an aggregate calibration score. A lightweight runtime selector uses the score plus model metadata and recent telemetry to select E4M3/E5M2/INT8 profile. - Safety-net shim: per-request fingerprint diff against cached prefix/KV statistics and log a drift score; if threshold exceeded, request is re-routed to fallback model variant and a retrain ticket is created automatically. - Canary plan: staged rollout across fleets (shadow -> 1% canary -> 10% canary -> 50% -> full) with regression gates on Console tied to the golden-eval suite. - Validation: cross-variant matrix covers 12 model families, 4 sequence lengths, and 3 batch shapes; automated runs produce a calibration report and a regression heatmap. Links: design doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/qe/FP8-orchestrator-design , calibration harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/calibration-harness/pulls/92 , initial PR for runtime shim: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1486

acceptance_criteria: Golden-eval regression <0.5% relative for 90% of models in the matrix across canary stage
Runtime fallback triggers and logs recorded in Console for any triggered fallback with root-cause tags
Calibration matrix generation automated and stored in artifact storage with reproducible seed
P95 latency uplift from selector < 3ms for 95% of requests in the canary fleet
Telemetry retention and dashboard panels exist for calibration_score, drift_score, fallback_rate, and per-profile token cost
qa_plan: Run golden-eval suite (sha: golden-2025-02-20) across calibration matrix in both simulated shadow and real canary fleets
Inject synthetic drift by perturbing activations on 2% of requests to validate fallback path and alerting
Regression tests: accuracy, perplexity, token-level BLEU for translation models, top-k reranking stability
Performance tests: end-to-end latency at seq=32/128/2048 with batch=1/4/16 on Hopper E4/E5 hardware profiles
Chaos test: kill GPU partition during in-flight requests to ensure graceful retry/fallback recorded in incident log
test_matrix: Metrics: calibration_score (float), drift_score (float), delta_perplexity, relative_F1, token_cost_delta
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Spurious drift signals on prefix-heavy workloads causing noisy fallbacks. Mitigation: prefix-weighted scoring and 2-tier hysteresis (soft-warning then hard-fallback).
Risk: Calibration nondeterminism across hardware. Mitigation: seed calibrations, add per-binary version tags and require golden-seed validation before promotion.
Risk: Increased token cost for conservative profile choice. Mitigation: cost-aware selector that prefers cheaper profile if calibration_score within safety margin.
Risk: Telemetry cardinality growth. Mitigation: roll up per-model metrics to model-family and sample 1% of requests for detailed traces.
